override.repo_standard: g2-review-handoff Allowed Scope + Constraints: tyre_supplant.py must NOT be modified (BLOCK-worthy beyond an additive change); reuse-not-reimplement is satisfied by import+call, and CREW_CONTEXT verify-seam discipline favors zero risk to existing session_type='R' callers.
override.reason: _read_clean_session_laps structurally mirrors tyre_supplant._read_clean_race_laps' SQL/clean-lap filter. The DRY-est fix (add a session_type param to _read_clean_race_laps in place) would touch tyre_supplant.py, an explicit scope violation. The local parameterized reader is the sanctioned reuse path; the shared regression body (race_degradation_slopes) IS imported/called unchanged, so no algorithmic logic is duplicated -- only a narrow read query. Standard subordinates the smell.

smells.note: Surfaced as a low-priority future-refactor possibility (consolidate the two readers once tyre_supplant.py is in scope) but correct for this gate.
_wear_corrected_pace consumes race_degradation_slopes' returned list; it reads a returned value, does not reach into another object's internals.

smells.finding: NON-BLOCKING OBSERVATION: the (year, gp_name, session_type, session_id) session-identity tuple recurs across fit_grip_baseline_from_laps, _thin_fallback_record, GripEstimateRecord construction, error_record, and _get_session_row. A small SessionKey value object would consolidate it. Low priority and deliberately NOT a blocker: g1's frozen GripEstimateRecord already fixes these as flat fields and error_record takes them positionally, so a value object would either diverge from the frozen g1 shape or require touching g1 (out of scope). Worth a note for a future consolidation, not this gate.

override.repo_standard: src/physics/layer2 established convention: session_type and compound are bare strings throughout the sibling modules (tyre_supplant.py uses bare 'R', DRY_COMPOUNDS = ('SOFT','MEDIUM','HARD') string tuples).
override.reason: Introducing enum/value types for session_type/compound here would diverge from the entire layer2 boundary convention and the frozen g1 record's field types, hurting consistency more than the smell costs. Repo-wide convention wins.

smells.finding: NON-BLOCKING OBSERVATION: _thin_fallback_record takes ~11 keyword-only args and fit_grip_baseline_from_laps ~10. Mitigated (all keyword-only, so call sites are self-documenting and _thin_fallback_record is a private helper extracted precisely to keep the public entry readable). Same root as the data-clumps note: folding the session-identity tuple + fit context into a small context object would shrink both signatures. Non-blocking; keyword-only form makes it acceptable as-is.

smells.note: Self-contained new module; no cross-cutting edit ripple.
Single reason to change (the grip-baseline fit); cohesive.
Only single attribute reads (rec.session_offset, sep.loo.oos_rmse is in tyre_supplant not here); no a.b().c().d() navigation chains.

The session_type generalization is REQUIRED by frozen decision:session-scope-uniform (actively used, not a speculative hook); min_stint_laps/fitted_at params have real callers/tests. No dead extension points.

Extensive comments/docstrings document statistical rationale (constant choices, frozen decisions, the surfaced fuel limitation) for genuinely complex stats code -- substantive reasoning the repo values, not masking bad code.
